enunciado: Sort {64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90} with bubble sort. Show the array at the end of each pass and the total number of comparisons and swaps.
objetivos: Implement bubble sort with two loops
Watch how the largest element 'bubbles' to the end on each pass
pistas: After pass p, the last p + 1 elements are already in place.
That is why the inner loop goes up to n - 1 - p.
